rows.text: stores `009078B0` at qword `+0` of `rcx`, then walks the circular list whose head is at `rcx+8` (first node at qword `rcx+8`, stopping when a node equals `rcx+8`), reading each node's next qword `+0` before calling vtable slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x18` with (`rcx+0x18`, the node, `r8d` = 0x18)
